title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction
figure_expansion: Explore the topic pages for the full collection, official resources, and contribution paths.
description: A map of scene perception, whole-scene reconstruction, scene generation, robotic interaction, embodied agents, and shared evaluation resources.

subtopics.label: Scene representations
subtopics.strategy: Learn point and volumetric features for large-scale 3D scene understanding.

subtopics.label: Objects and open vocabulary
subtopics.strategy: Segment scene instances and connect them to open-vocabulary descriptions.

subtopics.label: Language and spatial relations
subtopics.strategy: Ground descriptions and build scene relations for spatial reasoning.

subtopics.label: Functional scene elements
subtopics.strategy: Connect scene regions to actionable parts, tasks, and affordances.

subtopics.label: Geometry from observations
subtopics.strategy: Recover cameras and scene structure from images or RGB-D observations.

subtopics.label: Neural scene representations
subtopics.strategy: Represent captured appearance with neural fields or Gaussian primitives.

subtopics.label: Feed-forward geometry
subtopics.strategy: Predict camera parameters and dense scene geometry from images.

subtopics.label: Online maps and digital twins
subtopics.strategy: Update spatial maps over time or recover executable articulated structure.

subtopics.label: Layouts and scene graphs
subtopics.strategy: Generate object arrangements and semantic scene configurations.

subtopics.label: Conditioned scene synthesis
subtopics.strategy: Synthesize textured or Gaussian 3D environments from text and images.

subtopics.label: Procedural and task-driven worlds
subtopics.strategy: Construct environments with scene rules or language-specified requirements.

subtopics.label: Articulated assets
subtopics.strategy: Create part structure, joints, and programs for interactive objects.

subtopics.label: Affordances and contacts
subtopics.strategy: Identify where and how a robot can interact with objects and tools.

subtopics.label: Motion-aware control
subtopics.strategy: Use motion fields or articulation estimates to guide manipulation.

subtopics.label: Contact and adaptation
subtopics.strategy: Adapt articulated manipulation using tactile and visual feedback.

subtopics.label: Grounded and mobile execution
subtopics.strategy: Connect semantic parts, navigation, and control to physical tasks.

subtopics.label: Spatial maps and navigation
subtopics.strategy: Use spatial language maps and exploration to reach semantic goals.

subtopics.label: 3D reasoning and generalists
subtopics.strategy: Connect scene observations to questions, dialogue, and embodied tasks.

subtopics.label: Grounded task planning
subtopics.strategy: Translate language goals into plans tied to available robot skills.

subtopics.label: Vision-language-action policies
subtopics.strategy: Learn language-conditioned robot actions and adapt across tasks.

foundations.label: Scene observations
